notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
Hello,
The release date for Maid of Salvation has been confirmed for October 22, 2025 (PDT).


[previewyoutube="QNPBug48lbI;full"][/previewyoutube]
This is our first quarter-view action RPG.
It has been developed with a focus on unique combat that combines swordplay and firearms, reinterpreting the fun of 16-bit era quarter-view action RPGs for the modern generation.
We will continue polishing the game until release to ensure the highest quality. We greatly appreciate your continued interest and support.

For inquiries, please reach out via the discussion boards or email us at:
memory@oranpopcorn.com
